Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Economics BS at Vanderbilt University

What Vanderbilt University asks of applicants to Economics BS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Vanderbilt University courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 5 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Test-optional for fall 2027 and fall 2028 entry — applies to first-year, transfer, international and homeschool applicants
  • Applicants choose on the application whether to be considered with or without ACT/SAT scores; the choice does not advantage or disadvantage review
  • ACT or SAT will be required from fall 2029 entry
Verified19 Oct 2026Vanderbilt: Testing Policies · Vanderbilt: Testing Policies
English language
  • English proficiency test results required from international applicants, if applicable — not required where first language or language of instruction is English
  • Waived with ACT English above 26 or SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing above 630
  • Recommended minimum scores (not cut-offs): TOEFL iBT 5, TOEFL Essentials 10.5, IELTS 7.0, Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 185, LanguageCert 75, Duolingo 130

Vanderbilt labels these "recommended minimum" scores. The TOEFL iBT figure (5) is on the new 1–6 TOEFL band scale.

Verified19 Oct 2026Vanderbilt: Application Process: First-year
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Verified19 Oct 2026Vanderbilt: Application Process: First-year
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: Vanderbilt has no minimum coursework requirements; recommended coursework is 4 units of English, 4 of mathematics, 4 of natural science, 2 of foreign language, 2 of social science/humanities, plus 4 additional units in these or other academic areas. Applies to all Vanderbilt first-year applicants.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Vanderbilt: Application Process: First-year
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
International applicants must submit an official high school transcript with all classes and grades to date; leaving-exam results alone do not complete the application.

Vanderbilt’s admissions pages do not mention A-Levels by name — this row applies its general statement on leaving exams. (A-Level credit after enrolment is a catalog matter, not admission.)

Overall score

Details
Vanderbilt recommends taking IB (or AP/honours) courses where the school offers them, as appropriate.

Vanderbilt’s admissions pages say nothing about IB Diploma scores or predicted IB grades in admission; the IB 6/7 statement on the FAQ is about college credit after enrolling, not admission.
